ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Extremely low; surface is dominated by low-intensity pixels (black/dark grey) with high-intensity pixels limited to less than 2% of the total visible surface area as localized spots.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant contiguous dark pigmentation across both lobes. Mapping reveals isolated, non-contiguous high-contrast (yellow-white) pixel clusters located primarily in the medial and inner-lateral zones of the ventral surface.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous high-frequency serration along the entire trailing edge boundary. Amplitude of variations increases toward the distal tips, characterized by irregular peak-to-valley pixel heights.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Pronounced concave curve along the trailing edge leading to tapered, slightly convex distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Detection of approximately 12 distinct, roughly circular high-contrast pixel clusters (yellowish-white) distributed across the central-medial regions of both lobes.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extreme distal tips exhibit highly irregular, high-contrast pixel clusters and jagged geometric deformations, likely corresponding to concentrated barnacle colonization or terminal edge erosion.
